name: Godly Living
overview: Godly living calls believers to offer themselves wholly to God as living sacrifices, dedicated and pleasing to Him, which is described as a reasonable act of worship. This lifestyle involves a conscious rejection of worldly patterns and a continual transformation through the renewal of the mind, enabling believers to discern and fulfill God's perfect will. Additionally, godly living is evidenced by the fruit of the Spirit—qualities such as love, joy, peace, patience, gentleness, goodness, and faith—that reflect the Spirit's work in the believer's character.
